prs.tagLine: A cosmopolitan village with a creative spirit
prs.location:
Sandford Lodge, surrounded by some of Dublin’s finest parks in the leafy village of Ranelagh, gives you a chance to live alongside beautiful natural attractions.

You can train in the private gym onsite or catch up on the Sunday papers in the lounge. Having the village minutes from your door gives you more freedom to shop or dine whenever you like.

There are tempting eateries, traditional bars and stylish boutiques at every turn in Ranelagh. Stroll along the Grand Canal and watch the swans sail past or practice your sun salutations in nearby Herbert Park.

description:
These secluded and private 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments in the heart of Ranelagh village, framed by tall trees and lush parks, offer you a residence near green recreational areas in one of the most popular parts of the city. 

The morning sun fills each interior, creating bright and comfortable living spaces, bringing the beautiful design detail and finish of this boutique development to life. The landscaped gardens can be admired day or night from the vantage point of your balcony or patio. 

A dedicated onsite property manager makes life easy at Sandford Lodge. Available five days a week, this friendly professional takes care of service requests, onsite gym and more, along with maintaining the privacy and safety of the grounds. 

Private onsite amenities give you a better work-life balance. Book a training session at the residents' gym or read in the lounge.

Herbert Park is only five minutes away on foot, opening your social life to outdoor yoga classes, food festivals and local events.

Join a community of nature enthusiasts, health buffs and pleasure seekers who appreciate the outdoors and creative energy of Ranelagh's incredible eateries, bars and boutiques.

Virtual tours enable you to view apartments, and are helpful in illustrating the layout and interior style of a sample residence.
***Please note, photographs are for reference only; we have multiple unit types with various layouts***
